title: Uruguayan Empanada Filling
description: A delicious and savory filling for Uruguayan empanadas, made with wild garlic and a hint of uruguayan spices.

ingredients.name: wild garlic
ingredients.notes: Use fresh wild garlic for the best flavor

ingredients.name: leaves
ingredients.notes: Any leafy green like spinach or kale works well

ingredients.name: uruguayan
ingredients.notes: Uruguayan oregano has a distinct flavor, but regular oregano works too

ingredients.name: yummy
ingredients.notes: Add a pinch of cumin for extra flavor

ingredients.name: empanadas
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought empanadas work great

ingredients.name: jammy
ingredients.notes: Add a sprinkle of parsley for color and freshness

instructions: 1. In a pan over medium heat, sauté the minced wild garlic until fragrant.
2. Add the chopped leaves and cook until wilted.
3. Stir in the dried oregano and ground cumin. Cook for 1 minute.
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
5. Stuff each empanada with the garlic-leaves mixture.
6. Serve warm or at room temperature.
